Orange-pink Miniature.
Exhibition name: String of Pearls
rows.Bloom: Coral-pink, ages to light pink . Pompon, narrow petals. Moderate fragrance. Small, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders or container rose.
